messages:
maria: heads up — jordan DM'd me about a denied ER claim while traveling this weekend. can someone advise?

jordan: thanks @maria. i had an ER visit on 3/14 while traveling. insurer denied the claim saying the provider billed under a different clinic NPI, so they marked it as out-of-network. i attached the EOB and the invoice link: https://files.example/er-invoice-3-14.pdf

alex: @jordan — that sounds like an NPI/ billing hierarchy mismatch. two practical options: 1) ask the provider for a corrected itemized bill with the billing NPI that matches the facility on our plan; or 2) submit an appeal to the insurer with a written explanation + itemized bill + front/back of your insurance card + the EOB.

jordan: if i ask the provider for a corrected bill, how do i phrase it? they already gave me an invoice that looks like it belongs to a different group.

alex: keep it simple when requesting correction. e.g.:
```
To: billing@clinic.example
Subject: Request for corrected itemized bill (patient: Jordan R.)

Hi — I received an invoice for my 03/14/2025 ER visit that lists the billing provider as "Riverdale Urgent Care" (NPI xxxxx). Our insurer is denying the claim because the billed NPI does not match the facility that treated me. Please provide an itemized/corrected bill that includes the facility name and billing NPI that actually billed for the ER services or a corrected claim submission to insurer.

Thanks,
Jordan R.
DOB: 1991-04-06
Account: 1234567
```

sam: quick note from claims-bot: insurer appeal form here: https://insurer.example/forms/appeal — required docs: itemized bill, EOB, insurance card, signed patient statement. Standard turnaround 30-60 days after appeal receipt.

jordan: if the provider refuses to reissue, can we submit the appeal anyway?

alex: yes — submit appeal with a patient statement explaining the billing discrepancy + the invoice you have. include any screenshots/emails showing you requested correction. i'll help pull the appeal packet. please send docs to benefits@redwood.com and put "APPEAL: Jordan R. ER 03/14" in the subject.

maria: adding: if costs are >$2k or you need faster review, ping me and i'll escalate to our broker for an expedited review. also attach medical records if available (notes showing ER treatment).

jordan: thank you! sending docs now. appreciate the help. :thumbsup:

alex: once i submit, i'll post the confirmation number here. expect update in ~48 hours for submission confirmation, then insurer timeframe applies.

claims-bot: Submission checklist: [EOB, itemized bill, insurance card, patient statement] — use subject format: "APPEAL: <Name> <Date>" — tracking email: appeals@insurer.example

maria: perfect — marking this thread for follow-up. jordan, if you get a corrected bill, drop it here and we'll try resubmission first. thanks everyone. :pray:
